//: Lab bundle budget (#1411). Enforced by `npm run budget` after `npm run build`, in CI's frontend job. `entryJs` is the entry chunk — the number the audit quoted. `initialJs` is everything index.html makes the browser fetch before first paint (entry + modulepreloads), which is the honest one: splitting a page out of the entry can shrink entryJs while the browser still downloads the same bytes. All figures are gzip kB, level 6. Ceilings only go DOWN: run `npm run budget -- --update` to bank a shrink. Raising one is a deliberate, reviewable edit — say why in the commit message.
